QuestInfo.name: Continental Rarities
QuestInfo.1: Cassandra says that when the new continent was discovered, rare items started showing up in Maple World. She wants you to collect 10 of these fancy new items.
QuestInfo.2: You scored the items Cassandra wanted. Pretty neat!

0.0: #e#b#h0##k#n! Did you hear? A new continent was discovered south of Ossyria! I knew something was up when all these rare items started showing up. They must have come over from there. Can you bring some of them to me?

yes.0: Great! I know where you can find them. You will need to search the monsters. Like, inside. 'Cause I think those stupid monsters swallowed them all. Get some and bring them back to me.

no.0: I really want to see those items.
